task: round12 v_hyp_post_deadline r12p-4 (late-submission bed), skeptic VALUE+FEASIBILITY
reason: The mechanism is real: if the host enables late submissions, each one is scored on public and private without being ranked, and the hidden rerun does not use the weekly GPU quota (CONTEXT l.1972). But as a VALUE item it fails on five counts. (1) By construction it has 0 effect on our final rank. It exists only after 29 Sep 23:59, so it is learning, not a lever. (2) Under its own eligibility rule the bed has nothing to read. The same scan's ceilings (r12p-8 / r12p-1) put every INFERENCE-ONLY item on the frozen x138/K2 stack below or at the +0.003 lab cut: I-222 <= ~+0.003 pooled, coordhead-v2 <= +0.002, I-079 learned <= +0.004 (and it needs retraining), I-242 +0.0063 on 6bba only, and rule-based post-processing <= 0 realistic (combo oracle). Expected values are far below these ceilings. The only item that can move a score (the D detector program) needs retraining, so it is not 'frozen stack'. A budget of 15 late subs sizes a bed with ~0 eligible items. (3) The resolution arithmetic contradicts itself. It says 0.001 private ~ +0.006 lab at r = 1/6, yet items between +0.003 and +0.006 lab are admitted, and those map to ~+0.0005 private: a rounding coin flip. The read 'displayed delta >= +0.001' is sign-sound, because rounding is monotone and the kernels are deterministic. But a true +0.0002 passes ~20% of the time and a true +0.0009 shows 0 ~10% of the time, so the magnitude is only bounded to (0, 0.002). (4) 'Only true embryo-held-out bed' is overstated. After the deadline the private scores of all 39 old subs (r12p-3, zero cost) are an embryo-held-out table as well. Late subs add only NEW variants. (5) Smaller errors. 'No GPU quota' is half true: each submission still needs a committed notebook version (a 15-40 min commit run, CONTEXT l.341). Determinism was measured only on local reruns (CONTEXT l.796), not across hidden-rerun hardware. K2 also has wall-clock gates (REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 34200, DIVINS 28800 s), so an added stage that slows the hidden run can change the output through timing rather than through the mechanism. Feasibility is not in question: nothing is built or submitted before 29 Sep, it does not touch R1-R10, the finals or E10, and a disabled late-sub button falls back to G0. The problem is value and calibration, not feasibility.
fix: Downgrade to ONE info line for 30 Sep in CONTEXT section 11 (post-deadline): 'Check whether Late Submission is enabled. If yes, a late sub is the private read for a NEW inference-only variant; it has no rank effect.' Replace the usage rule with: (a) eligibility = pre-declared lab effect >= +0.006 pooled on both embryos (not EV >= +0.003), so a 0.001 display step is expected at r = 1/6. Retrained-weight arms (D program) are allowed only after the r12p-5 paired-retrain gate, and are labelled 'not frozen stack'. (b) Read: displayed private delta vs #37 >= +0.001 = sign confirmed, magnitude in (0, 0.002). Displayed 0 = inconclusive, never 'no effect'. (c) Log the hidden-run latency of every late sub; a run that crosses 28800 s or 34200 s is void for the mechanism read. (d) Drop the fixed 15-sub budget: size it from the eligible list, expected <= 2-3 items. (e) Run r12p-3 (the free 39-sub private table) FIRST; late subs only for variants the old submissions do not cover. No change before 29 Sep. Finals, E10 and R1-R10 are untouched.
realistic_gain: 0 on the competition result (post-deadline by construction). As learning it gives at most 1-3 sign reads on the private embryos after 30 Sep, and only if late subs are enabled and a >= +0.006 lab inference-only item appears, which the round-11/12 ceilings make unlikely. Cost ~0.5 GPU-h commit per sub plus ~7.5 h wall-clock hidden run.
